sources.role: official project description and download page

linux.reason: OdyWeb is a browser HTML/JavaScript artifact, not a native Linux package; no persistent host-controller or desktop integration contract is published.

linux-flatpak.reason: No OdyWeb Flatpak package or manifest is published; browser sandbox persistence is outside the artifact contract.

windows.reason: OdyWeb is a browser HTML/JavaScript artifact, not a native Windows package; no persistent host-controller or desktop integration contract is published.

macos.reason: OdyWeb is a browser HTML/JavaScript artifact, not a native macOS package; no persistent host-controller or desktop integration contract is published.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent an OdyWeb controller file: the self-contained HTML artifact keeps keyboard state in memory and supplies no persistent host-controller grammar.

notes: The archive contains only OdyWeb.html and Odyweblogo.png. JavaScript page state and FileReader overlay selection are runtime behavior; browser launch and effective gameplay input were not verified.
